checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
must.why: Two candles fill the frame; the lit amber one is the clear focal point.

must.item: The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
must.why: Edges are clean. The lit jar has a slightly odd wick and rim, but nothing is visibly warped.

must.item: The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
must.why: Only the candles, a travertine slab and a eucalyptus sprig appear.

must.item: Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
must.why: Warm side light, a beige backdrop and a stone stand give a cohesive, premium look.

faults.what: Two candles appear, an amber jar with a lit wick and a cream jar with a gold lid. The brief described one candle, with the amber glass jar having a gold lid. The result is a duplicate or mismatch.
The travertine slab is cropped at the left and right edges, and the eucalyptus sprig is cut off at the right edge.
The wick on the lit candle looks slightly odd.

summary: A polished, premium-looking square shot of two LUMEN candles on travertine with eucalyptus. The label text is clean. The main deviation is a second candle where the brief described one, with the lid on the wrong jar.
